sections.heading: Urgent Medical Care. Right Inside Your Hotel.
sections.subheading: 24/7 Medical Care • Cashless Insurance • Multilingual Support
body: 24/7 Clinic operates a network of on-site urgent care clinics inside hotels and resorts across Egypt’s leading tourist destinations, giving international travelers fast access to medical care without unnecessary hospital visits.

Supporting points:

sections.heading: Medical Care Without Leaving Your Resort
body: When you become ill or injured while travelling, visiting a hospital should not always be the first step.

24/7 Clinic brings urgent and primary medical care directly into hotels and resorts, allowing international guests to receive medical consultation, diagnostics and treatment close to their hotel room.
Our medical teams can manage a wide range of conditions on-site and coordinate hospital care only when medically necessary.
Hospital care when necessary - not automatically.
devNotes: Reuse an existing About / Intro block where possible.
Optional highlighted line: Hospital care when necessary - not automatically.

sections.heading: Why Leave Your Hotel When Medical Care Is Already There?

items.title: Inside Your Resort
items.text: No need to search for an unfamiliar medical facility in another part of the city.

items.title: Fast Access to Medical Care
items.text: Our hotel-based model gives travelers direct access to medical support where they are staying.

items.title: Treatment On-Site
items.text: Many common urgent and primary care conditions can be assessed and treated without a hospital visit.

items.title: Hospital Transfer Only When Needed
items.text: If higher-level care is required, our team coordinates the appropriate hospital, ambulance or next medical step.

devNotes: Add a new four-card section.

sections.heading: What We Can Treat On-Site

items.title: Urgent Medical Care
items.text: Assessment and treatment of sudden illness, fever, infections, gastrointestinal conditions, dehydration, respiratory problems and other urgent conditions.

items.title: Injuries & Minor Procedures
items.text: Treatment of wounds, burns, sprains, minor trauma, dressings, suturing and other minor procedures where clinically appropriate.

items.title: Diagnostics & Laboratory Tests
items.text: Medical assessment with access to laboratory tests and diagnostic services when required.

items.title: IV Therapy & Medication
items.text: Doctor-prescribed medication, injections and IV therapy when medically indicated.

items.title: Specialist Consultation
items.text: Access to specialist physicians and coordinated consultations where further medical assessment is required.

items.title: Hotel Room Doctor Visit
items.text: When appropriate, a doctor visit can be arranged directly in the guest’s hotel room.

devNotes: Replace the current service emphasis with urgent and traveler-focused healthcare.
Use six cards.

sections.heading: Travelling With Medical Insurance?
sections.subheading: We Can Coordinate Directly With Your Insurer
body: 24/7 Clinic works with international travel insurers and assistance companies worldwide.
Where insurance approval and policy conditions allow, we can arrange cashless medical treatment, meaning the patient may not need to pay the full medical cost upfront and claim it back later.
devNotes: This should become one of the strongest homepage conversion blocks.
Important: Do not guarantee cashless treatment universally.
Always use wording such as: “subject to insurance approval and policy conditions” or: “where approved by the insurer.”

sections.heading: Getting Medical Help Is Simple

items.title: Message Us on WhatsApp
items.text: Tell us your hotel, location and what happened.

items.title: We Find the Nearest Medical Option
items.text: If your hotel has a 24/7 Clinic, we direct you there. If not, our coordination team identifies the most appropriate medical solution.

items.title: We Check Your Insurance
items.text: Send us your insurance details and, where applicable, our team can coordinate directly with your insurer.

items.title: Receive Medical Care
items.text: Treatment is provided on-site whenever clinically appropriate. If higher-level care is needed, we coordinate the next step.

devNotes: Add a four-step section.
